scenario.label_zh: 请室友帮忙移走窗边蜘蛛
scenario.goal_zh: 辨认窗边蜘蛛并商定不直接用手接触的移走办法

context_zh: 室友发现蜘蛛停在窗框旁，希望不用手直接接触就把它移到室外。
author: author-phase05-a

sentences.speaker: Owen
sentences.text: Sorry to bother you, but could you help me with the spider by the window?

sentences.speaker: Rina
sentences.text: The one sitting beside that web?

sentences.speaker: Owen
sentences.text: Yes. I want to open the window, but I do not want to touch it.

sentences.speaker: Rina
sentences.text: I can put a glass over it and slide a card underneath.

sentences.speaker: Owen
sentences.text: Thanks. I will open the other window so you can put it outside.

sentences.speaker: Rina
sentences.text: There, it is on the card now. Keep that window clear for a moment.

sentences.speaker: Owen
sentences.text: It is outside. Thank you. I can close this window now.
